purpose: Untouched until the single final validation run of the swing v4 round (phase 3). Never used to design, tune, select or diagnose.

time_holdout.end: latest data at the time of the final run
time_holdout.rule: the last 2 years before the creation date. During development every price series is cut before this date (protocol.install_dev_cutoff), for every ticker incl. SPY, VIX and breadth inputs.

ticker_holdout.rule: S&P 500 members of ~2015 that never appeared in any universe, test, PROGRESS.md or Pine default of this repo; 5-11 per GICS sector, chosen by membership around 2015 (not by later performance), deliberately including later laggards / index drop-outs (KSS, M, XRX, NWL, VFC, LUMN, IVZ, BEN, F, VTRS, BIIB, MOS).

excluded_no_data.IPG: no data: acquired by Omnicom (2025), delisted

ticker_holdout.access: only the availability of data was checked (first/last date); no returns or signals were computed.

development.universe: every ticker already used in earlier sessions (DEV, HOLDOUT, TRAIN_EXTRA, VOLATILE, LOCKBOX, LOCKBOX2 = 253 tickers): all were already seen by earlier research, so only the new set above is clean
development.model_training: DEV (CORE + DEV_EXTRA, 15 tickers) as in v3, refit yearly on trades closed before 1 Jan of the test year
development.halves: sorted development universe split into even / odd positions (A / B) for the 'works in both halves' check

caveats: the v3 base parameters (n 20, m 20, trail 4, ibs 0.7, keep 0.75) were chosen in earlier sessions with data up to 2026, so the TIME holdout is clean for new ideas but not fully for the baseline itself; the TICKER holdout is clean for both
